evidence.detail: The exact v308 internal class name is rs/tools/TextPopupWindow; the readable noun survives directly in the class path rather than being inferred from obfuscated behavior.
The class directly extends javax.swing.JFrame, accepts a window-title String in its constructor, calls setTitle, uses EXIT_ON_CLOSE, sets an explicit 989x571 size, and makes itself visible.
The window owns a dedicated JTextPane subclass inside a JScrollPane, configures it non-editable with visible caret/selection state, and exposes the pane through a public accessor.
Its public String method delegates into the configured text writer with the pane's StyledDocument and a SimpleAttributeSet, matching a reusable styled-text popup window responsibility.
The constructor wires focus and keyboard helper classes around the text pane, including a Ctrl+F binding, further corroborating that this is a standalone searchable/readable text popup surface.
